name: Process Step
description: One question an operator answers. Everything about how it behaves — what kind of answer it takes, its pass band, whether it wants a photo or a scan, what happens when it fails — is configuration on this row. Adding a step to a process is a Desk edit, never a deploy.

fields.label: Step Code
fields.description: Stable identifier. Conditions, actions and run history all refer to it, so it must survive reordering and relabelling.

fields.label: Stage
fields.description: The stage_code this step belongs to.

fields.label: Display No.
fields.description: The number the operator sees, e.g. the number printed on the original paper sheet. Independent of sequence.

fields.label: Section
fields.description: Screen grouping — steps sharing a section render on one screen.

fields.label: Label (Alt Language)
fields.description: Hindi / regional rendering, shown under the label. Editable by the plant — not a translation file.

fields.label: Method
fields.description: Free text shown as a chip: Visual, Functional, Torque, Document.

fields.label: Reference Image — Good
fields.description: What a passing result looks like. The highest-value field on this table for a new operator.

fields.label: Reaction Plan
fields.description: What to do when this step fails. Carrying it on the step is what puts the control plan at the point of use (IATF 16949).

fields.label: Response Type
fields.options:
Choice
Choice Multi
Number
Number in Range
Number with Tolerance
Computed
Text Short
Text Long
Yes No
Date
Datetime
Photo Only
Scan
Signature
Link
Section Note

fields.label: Outcome Set
fields.description: The answer vocabulary — Pass/Fail/NA, three-tier, anything. Shared across steps so a wording fix lands everywhere at once.

fields.label: Computed From
fields.description: A safe expression over earlier step codes, e.g. MAX(CELL_V_MAX) - MIN(CELL_V_MIN) or DIFF(A,B). Parsed, never eval()'d.

fields.label: Nominal
fields.description: For Number with Tolerance — the target, e.g. 10 Nm.

fields.label: Pass Condition
fields.options:
Within Range
Greater Than Min
Less Than Max
Equals Nominal
Any Value

fields.label: Photo Policy
fields.options:
Always
On Fail
On Pass
Never
fields.description: On Fail is the speed sweet spot — evidence where it matters, no tax on a clean run.

fields.label: Photo Hint
fields.description: What to shoot, e.g. 'close-up of the weld joint'.

fields.label: Scan Count
fields.description: How many of this entity to capture here. A scan is never mandatory — manual entry and skip always remain.

fields.label: Critical
fields.description: A failure here quarantines the run and can block the next stage.

fields.label: Mandatory
fields.description: Must be answered before the stage can be submitted. Default off — the engine prefers soft gates.

fields.label: Skip Reasons
fields.description: One per line. Becomes a dropdown so skipping never needs free text.

fields.label: Score Weight
fields.description: Contribution to the run score. 0 excludes this step from scoring entirely.

fields.label: Expected Seconds
fields.description: Baseline for the fast-entry advisory on the report. Advisory only — never blocks.

fields.label: Active
fields.description: Retire a step without deleting the history that refers to it.

fields.label: Action Set
fields.description: What happens automatically on this step's outcome — notify, raise a deviation, quarantine. Shared, so changing who gets alerted is one edit rather than twenty.
